mapper.select: select pro_position_content.* from pro_position_content pro_position_content left join position_info position_info on pro_position_content.position_id = position_info.id where pro_position_content.item_code = #{itemCode} and (pro_position_content.pro_line_code =#{proLineCode} or pro_position_content.pro_line_code ='000') and pro_position_content.type =1 and pro_position_content.is_ok = 1 and position_info.task_state=0 and position_info.inven_state=1 and position_info.disable_state=0 order by pro_position_content.in_time asc limit 1

select pro_line_code as line_code ,pro_position_content.item_code, MAX(item_info.item_name) as item_name, COUNT(1) as totalNum, SUM(is_ok) as hasNum, MAX(line_item.quantity) as limit_num, MAX(item_type.name) as item_type_name, MAX(pro_line.name) as line_name, MAX(ware_info.code) as ware_code, MAX(ware_info.name) as ware_name from pro_position_content pro_position_content left join position_info position_info on pro_position_content.code = position_info.code left join item_info item_info on item_info.item_code = pro_position_content.item_code left join item_type item_type on item_type.code = item_info.item_type_code left join pro_line pro_line on pro_line.code = pro_position_content.pro_line_code left join ware_info ware_info on pro_line.ware_code = ware_info.code left join line_item line_item on line_item.line_code = pro_position_content.pro_line_code and line_item.item_code = pro_position_content.item_code where pro_position_content.type=1 GROUP BY pro_line_code,pro_position_content.item_code;

select pro_line_code as line_code ,pro_position_content.item_code ,item_info.item_name ,COUNT(1) as totalNum,sum(is_ok) as hasNum ,line_item.quantity as limit_num ,item_type.name as item_type_name ,pro_line.name as line_name from pro_position_content pro_position_content left join position_info position_info on pro_position_content.code = position_info.code left join item_info item_info on item_info.item_code = pro_position_content.item_code left join item_type item_type on item_type.code = item_info.item_type_code left join pro_line pro_line on pro_line.code = pro_position_content.pro_line_code left join line_item line_item on line_item.line_code = pro_position_content.pro_line_code and line_item.item_code = pro_position_content.item_code where pro_position_content.type=1 and pro_position_content.ware_code = #{wareCode} GROUP BY pro_line_code,pro_position_content.item_code;
